scope: Synthetic engineering compatibility only; no scientific release or accuracy claim
decision_acceptance: Zero changes versus BOTH PyTorch FP32 and ONNX FP32 in NLI maxima/ties, review flags/reasons, abstention and unavailable states
contract_acceptance: Exact token IDs/masks, evidence/offsets, deterministic labels, modality/identity gates, budgets and closed research gates
numerical_acceptance: Finite logits and valid normalized probabilities required. Logit/probability drift is descriptive; no FP32 numerical tolerances are applied to INT8 and no numerical equivalence is claimed
justification: INT8 is lossy. Exact decisions test compatibility with the unchanged review controller; arbitrary relaxed probability thresholds would not establish that compatibility
failure_action: Retain the single candidate as experimental; report every disagreement; do not tune rules, thresholds or quantization settings to force parity

quantization.nodes: Explicit allowlist: existing MatMul nodes with a constant FLOAT rank-2 weight as input B
quantization.other_operators: Excluded; dynamic attention MatMuls and classifier Gemm nodes remain unquantized
